kitDescription: Aria is a Water MG Attacker whose kit is pure team crit support with no damage lines of her own. At the start of every Full Burst — including ones she did not cast — she gives all allies Critical Damage +26.99% for 10 seconds. Each time she empties her 300-round belt, she gives all allies Critical Rate +7.03% for 5 seconds, so that buff's uptime is paced by her magazine-and-reload cycle. Her Burst II shields the whole team for 37.86% of her own final Max HP for 10 seconds, and separately gives herself Hit Rate +30.37% for 15 seconds, outlasting the Full Burst window by 5 seconds.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every kit line is either FAITHFUL or a documented ⚑ gap with estimate, recipe, and tier. The two load-bearing trigger-identity traps (S1 fullBurstEnter vs burstCast; burst self-lines burstCast vs fullBurstEnter) were read identically by S2b, S5, S6, and the driver, and the driver's STARVED comp discriminates both directions maximally — the strongest evidence in the packet. S2's unscoped-vs-scoped stat trap is discriminated three ways. The adapted S5 run is 32/0 GREEN against the shipped override with all 5 adaptations structurally justified (the fixture rebuild was mandated by S2b's own non-vacuity warning — controlComp genuinely starves aria to zero casts — and the Hit-Rate adaptation corrected a blind-side engine-fact misread, not a driver defect). The only non-faithful behavior is the engine-wide absence of an MG Hit-Rate→core channel, which is documented, canary-pinned, and not aria-specific. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: all agents share the prose-literal priors that (a) 'last bullet hits' = once-per-belt lastBullet and (b) S1's ~50%-uptime reading rests on the unverified datamine MG cadence tuple (⚑1) — one focused aria video (rounds/min + reload gap) closes both.
